"""Standalone repro of Django ticket: i18n_patterns with locale containing
both script and region (en-latn-us / en-Latn-US) -> 404. Expected: 200 'U!'.
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
    ],
    LANGUAGE_CODE="en-us",
    LANGUAGES=[
        ("en-us", "English"),
        ("en-latn-us", "Latin English"),
        ("en-Latn-US", "BCP 47 case format"),
    ],
    MIDDLEWARE=[
        "django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware",
        "django.middleware.locale.LocaleMiddleware",
    ],
    ROOT_URLCONF=__name__,
    USE_I18N=True,
    ALLOWED_HOSTS=["*"],
)

from django.conf.urls.i18n import i18n_patterns  # noqa: E402
from django.http import HttpResponse  # noqa: E402
from django.urls import path  # noqa: E402


def bangiah(request):
    return HttpResponse("U!")


urlpatterns = i18n_patterns(
    path("", bangiah),
)

django.setup()

from django.test import Client  # noqa: E402

client = Client()
ok = True
for url, expected_status in [
    ("/en-us/", 200),
    ("/en-latn-us/", 200),
    ("/en-Latn-US/", 200),
]:
    resp = client.get(url)
    status = resp.status_code
    body = resp.content.decode()
    mark = "OK " if (status == expected_status and body == "U!") else "FAIL"
    if mark == "FAIL":
        ok = False
    print(f"{mark} GET {url} -> {status} {body!r} (expected {expected_status} 'U!')")

print("RESULT:", "ALL PASS" if ok else "FAILURES PRESENT")
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
